newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO Q2 GDP GROWTH MAY TOP 5.5 PCT-GOVT OFFICIAL.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO Q2 GDP GROWTH MAY TOP 5.5 PCT-GOVT OFFICIAL.

text.p: Mexico's economic growth may have exceeded 5.5 percent in the second quarter, a Finance Ministry official said on Wednesday.
The country's gross domestic product "was very vigorous in the second quarter. It could be more than 5.5 percent in the second quarter," Finance Ministry spokesman Alejandro Valezuela told reporters.
A Reuter survey of analysts showed an average forecast of second-quarter GDP growth at 5.95 percent. The figure is due to be announced on August 19.
The spokesman reiterated the government's most recent estimate of annual GDP growth of 4.5 percent, above the earlier official forecast of 4.0 percent for the year.
He also said inflation would come in very close to 15 percent, as the government forecast earlier in the year.
